outcome: All six original review findings are resolved at this source snapshot. Source-level seal ordering, train-only optimizer, full SH and bounded selected-row permissions pass. Actual production execution and human visual quality are not asserted by this CPU review.

R01.evidence: media crop cell=max(native ROI width,210); raw native crop is centered inside cell, exact keys have adequate label width.

R02.evidence: preparation now stores nonband; objective out=view[nonband]; evaluation uses the same1-max(internal_band,outline_band) field.

R03.evidence: load_reference converts original RGBA to float64/255, composites RGB*AA+(1-AA), truncates to uint8, then explicitly resizes RGB with BICUBIC. This matches stock float64 compositing/truncation/default RGB PIL resize. AA coverage remains separately BILINEAR and is not Gaussian identity.

R04.evidence: Holdout read requires matching actual scene from original source path, DATA_FREEZE SHA, nonempty edit SHA/dev summaries, matching selection and target seals, and matching every persisted edit SHA before image hash/open. Actual metadata scene paths resolve correctly for Lego and Chair.

R06.evidence: runtime.guard aggregates OUT+EXP+ART bytes for the16GiB cap while preserving root4GiB/commonGit1.5GiB reserves and live ownership queries.

remaining_notes.issue: At snapshot, videos ownership gate is once per four-arm camera-path collection, not once per video arm.
remaining_notes.recommendation: Add guard for each video arm before freezing production source if each video is an execution unit.

limitations: Production not executed by this reviewer; no image or GPU evidence was read in this final pass.
Runner is durable through per-arm npz/progress/epoch files but refuses automatic rerun if FINAL exists; any failed-scene resume needs explicitly verified units, as its error metadata states.
Reporting final phase correctly records partial scene failure; generic narrative completion sentences should be read together with actual scene status if a scene fails.
Independent human visual GO remains pending.
